cases.name: Mia Maro
cases.about: She was a senior at Victor Andrew High School.
cases.narrative: He allegedly brutally beat her with a metal pole and a rubber mallet. He was found lying next to body, and had self-inflicted cuts to his wrists and neck, and had ingested medications, according to police. He was taken to an area hospital. She had suffered “extensive hemorrhaging and bleeding” in her brain due to repeated strikes to the head, and she also had suffered wounds to her forearms, hands, legs and feet. A metal pole was located in the kitchen, which contained blood and hair, and a rubber mallet was located in the garage, officials said.

cases.name: Halema Kassem
cases.about: A fundraiser in her honor stated, "Halema Kassem, one of the twins, was a soon to be pharmacy graduate with the intention of becoming a clinical pharmacist. Halema let out her creativity through henna art. Her smile lit the room, and her hand carried the excitement to express her creativity through henna.  She always put in extra effort to satisfy her family and friends. Halema was not only a Palestinian activist but an advocate for anyone that was in need of emotional support despite her being a victim domestic violence. Anyone that interacted with Halema knew how gentle and soft her heart was."

cases.name: Majeda Kassem
cases.about: A fundraiser in her memory stated, "Majeda devoted her life to her religion and family. She had a passion for cooking and never failed to make the most outstanding dishes. She was a great mother and role model to her kids that would positively influence her children to devote their lives to Islam."
cases.narrative: He allegedly shot her seven times. She sustained one gunshot to the wrist, one to the chest, one to the rear base of her neck, a graze wound to the back of her head, and three wounds that formed a triangle to the rear of her head near her right ear. Their son saw his father approach his mother, who was on the ground, and shoot her twice.

cases.about: A fundraiser in her honor stated, "Zahia Kassem also known as Zee and a twin that graduated as a radiology technician and planning to take her exam in less than a week. She was an outspoken, lighthearted soul that would win a anyone's heart with her charismatic personality. Zahia made it a goal for both herself and others to look and feel good about themselves. Zahia was an ambitious woman who always accomplished anything she put her mind to. One of them being her dream to go to umrah."
